<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s).

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx`  _(via new_window (literal, a string literal in NavigationModeSchema), openNewTab (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-map.mdx`  _(via new_window (literal, a string literal in NavigationModeSchema), openNewTab (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-timeline.mdx`  _(via new_window (literal, a string literal in NavigationModeSchema), openNewTab (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`  _(via new_window (literal, a string literal in NavigationModeSchema))_
- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`  _(via new_window (literal, a string literal in NavigationModeSchema))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via NavigationConfigSchema (symbol, a top-level const), openNewTab (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via new_window (literal, a string literal in NavigationModeSchema))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **9** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1ff80d342761eeda0272f33e222ffed6dcfc3e2c` — the merge of head `25a30f2090d2c89cef67e0fcac62a7591c59f2e4` into base `170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1ff80d342761eeda0272f33e222ffed6dcfc3e2c && git checkout 1ff80d342761eeda0272f33e222ffed6dcfc3e2c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698 25a30f2090d2c89cef67e0fcac62a7591c59f2e4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698 && git merge --no-ff 25a30f2090d2c89cef67e0fcac62a7591c59f2e4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读
- 按您的规则改了从列表打开记录的方式：点记录名称直接进整页；鼠标移到某一行时，名称旁出现「在侧边打开」小图标，点它才在右侧打开，列表还在。手机上点名称进整页。
- 「选项」里的「打开记录：抽屉 / 整页」设置去掉了，以前存的个人偏好不再起作用；抽屉里「撑满」的状态也去掉了，只留一个放大按钮，点了进整页。
- 抽屉改成四周留边、圆角带阴影的悬浮卡片。从列表进整页时会记住来自哪个列表（视图、筛选、排序、条数），刷新不丢，返回时回到原来的位置；地址栏里不多任何东西。
- 视图上的「打开方式」设置标记为废弃：旧的写法照常加载不报错，但不再起作用；写了「不打开」的列表仍然不打开。
- 席位意见：通过。改动超过 3000 行且涉及对外规范，需要席位做接口复核再交人工合并；合并前在更新说明里补两点（见下）。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · head `c35de251b9` · Fixes #35854 (epic #35590; maintainer named the card 14:23Z; deprecation ruling 「废弃」, card comment 7039654214) · K=6 · merge-tree vs `origin/main` clean · governed: no · +1091/−1917, 80 files (**3008 > 3000**) · CI 65 success, 13 skipped, 0 pending · 2026-11-20T19:26Z

**reviewFace** (committed file list + PR body declarations): face **`schema`**, tier **`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`**, `hits.schema` = `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.navigation-mode-record-open-deprecated.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`; `hits.rules = []`. Routing: **L2 by the seat at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, then Tier H (over 3000 lines): a human merge by GOVERNED_APPROVERS.**

Checked:
- Row click (`handleRowClick`): no record surface → nothing; `navOverlay.mode === 'none'` → nothing, a modifier click included (#33548 kept); ⌘/Ctrl/middle → the hook's new-tab path; otherwise `navigateTo(id)`, the full page with this list as origin. The handler stays stable (`rowClickInputs` ref), so the list does not re-render on `?recordId=`.
- Mode derivation: phone → the derived mobile surface; authored `none` or `preventNavigation: true` → `none`; everything else → `drawer` with the authored `width` / `size`. So `drawer` / `page` / `new_window` change nothing, as the semantic entry says.
- Side panel: `openInPanel` exists only for `mode === 'drawer'` on a non-phone viewport and rides the existing `recordLinkAdornment` channel (the slot that carried the old "open as page" arrow), so it sits inside the name cell with no fixed column. It pushes `?recordId=`, keeping the drawer shareable and refresh-safe.
- Drawer ⤢: root → close + `handleNavOverlayNavigate` (list origin kept); a deeper level → `expandedRecordPath` with the levels below as `?from=`. Maximize-in-place and its width math are gone; 「收为抽屉」 is gone with it.
- Provenance in `location.state.from` (point 2): survives reload, nothing new in the URL; `total` is added only when the sibling set is unscoped and `total ≥` the rows shown.
- Spec (for the L2, point 1): the key stays and `default('drawer')` stays, so every value parses; `@deprecated` + `[DEPRECATED]` describe and form help text; a D3 semantic entry with no conversion, which is right because stripping `none` would change behaviour. The retired-member FIX sentence is updated in the same file, and its pin test follows.
- Removed tests (point 4) pin only the removed preference, the Display menu section and maximize-in-place; their replacements are `recordOpenPath-35854` (unit) and `record-open-path-35854` (live e2e).
- Surface: claim 7042020341 + amendments 2–7, per ux-4; no plugin-grid change, since the adornment channel already existed.

Required before landing:
- **R1 (`openNewTab`, text or code; the L2 picks).** `navigation.openNewTab: true` ("Force open in new tab (applies to page mode)") used to make the object list open the page in a new tab. A plain name click now runs `navigateTo(id)` and ignores it. Either honour it on the name click, or say in the changeset and the semantic entry that it no longer applies to the object list. No first-party metadata sets it.
- **R2 (changeset migration lines).** `@object-ui/components` drops `NavigationOverlay`'s `maximizable` prop and the `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_FALLBACK` / `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON_FALLBACK` exports. AGENTS.md §changesets: a removed export carries FROM → TO and a one-line fix ("delete `maximizable`; the drawer's ⤢ opens the full page", "inline `'16rem'` / `'3rem'`"). Add the ADR-0087 marker too if `check:adr-0087-registration` counts it as breaking.

Nits (no action required):
- Point 3: `ConsoleToaster` keys its inset detection on ≤ 16px from the edge; a future card wider inset would need that number moved with it.
- Point 5: the stale ADR-0050 note is in #35870; nothing here edits `docs/adr`.

## Contract review

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `56c006efaef8592ceb61313f15901563d6f395a8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.navigation-mode-record-open-deprecated.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewOpenAsPage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx, packages/spec/src/ui/navigation-mode-retirement.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.recordOpenPath-35854.test.tsx

Two must-fix (M1 the declaration, M2 the entry's reach), three should-fix, three nits. The open-path code itself agrees with the ruling; the failures are in what the PR declares and prescribes.

### ① Derived judgments

- `@objectstack/spec` accept set: unchanged. `mode` keeps `NavigationModeSchema.default('drawer')`, all four values parse, the three retired members are refused as before (only their shared FIX sentence moved, and its pin moved with it). No export added or removed. Right.
- Meaning on a Console object list (`objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` 190–224, 367–389): `drawer`, `page`, `new_window` resolve to the same config as no key; `none` and `preventNavigation: true` return first and open nothing, a modifier click included. Matches the describe and the entry. Right. `Metadata-protocol: semantic` is the right kind.
- `openNewTab` (the L1 question): honoured. The derived config carries `openNewTab: authored?.openNewTab`; `handleRowClick` sends a plain click down `overlay.handleClick`, and the hook's `mode === 'new_window' || navigation.openNewTab` branch calls `onNavigate(id, 'new_window')`, which is `window.open(listRecordDetailUrl(…), '_blank')`. `none` and `preventNavigation` outrank it; the side-panel icon is unaffected; a phone returns the derived mobile surface first, so the flag does not apply there, as on main. Pinned in `ObjectView.recordOpenPath-35854.test.tsx` 241–252. This widens the flag's meaning: on main a default or `drawer` view with `openNewTab: true` opened the drawer and the flag was inert; now it opens a new tab. The changeset says so; the entry and the key's describe do not (S1).
- `@object-ui/components`: `NavigationOverlayProps.maximizable` is retired. The type is on the published entry (`src/custom/index.ts` 40–46). A public-surface narrowing, declared `no`. Wrong (M1).
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`: `ListViewProps.recordOpen` is retired; the type is on the published entry (`src/index.tsx` 28). A narrowing, undeclared and with no FROM → TO line. Wrong (M1).
- `@object-ui/i18n`: six language-pack keys leave and `console.objectView.openInSidePanel` arrives. By the house reading both move the surface. Declared `no`. Wrong (M1).
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is private; nothing it drops reaches a consumer. Right.
- First-party metadata: nothing depends on a dropped mode. Showcase pages and the console sdui preview declare `none` only, which every renderer still honours; `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts` 71 declares `drawer`, now inert (N2). Surfaces still reading the dropped modes: the shared `useNavigationOverlay` hook behind every page block (M2), Studio's kanban card inspector (S3), the bare `/data` page (#35875, carded).

### ② Semver level

Levels pass: `semantic` takes `minor` on `@objectstack/spec`, no `major`, and `Check Changeset` is green on this head. The declaration line does not match the diff.

M1 (must-fix) — `Clause-②: no` is wrong, in the changeset and the PR body. The diff retires two members of exported types on published entries and moves the i18n pack keys. The house test for `no` is "no export, prop, type member or i18n key is added or removed" (`ui/packages/components/CHANGELOG.md` states it three times, nearly in those words), and the sibling change in this same family, the split-pane retirement (`ea150b7`), carried `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, a `**BREAKING**` banner, a `!` title and a `runtime-export-retired` marker for the same kinds of removal. ADR-0087 names dropping the token to stay green as the shape to stop repeating. Owed: the narrowing arm, the banner, one ADR-0087 disposition marker naming `@object-ui/components#NavigationOverlayProps.maximizable` and `@object-ui/plugin-list#ListViewProps.recordOpen`, and a FROM → TO block naming exactly those operands. The `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_FALLBACK` / `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON_FALLBACK` line must go: both left the package entry in an earlier release (`7da99b7`) and were not reachable at this branch's base. The L1 closure of R2 ("no declared-breaking changeset, so no marker is owed") reads the gate off the declaration it is meant to check. The dev report's `dogfood_battery: n/a` rests on the same missing arm and is owed again once the arm is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Nothing to answer.
- L1 R1 (`openNewTab`): verified in the code and the pin, above. Closed. L1 R2: not closed, see M1.
- Out-of-scope b (#35875, the `/data` page still opens the drawer on a row click): accepted as carded. Until it lands, "the console's object list has one rule" is not true of that page.
- Out-of-scope c (#35870, ADR-0050 note and `skills/**`): accepted. ADR-0050 names `NavigationMode` only as existing vocabulary in its background and one dated note; no decision of it is reversed here, so Prime Directive 13 is not breached. The skill eval that expects `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` teaches an inert key until #35870 lands.
- NOT-MEASURED gates and the OOM-killed `ui/scripts` run in the dev report: answered by this head's check-runs, all success or skipped (the one cancelled `PR-body guards` run is superseded by a success).
- SQL push-down: no finding. Provenance adds one number (`total`, the list's own matched count) to history state beside the row ids the list already published; no new id materialisation, no in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

M2 (must-fix) — the semantic entry prescribes deletion on a surface where the modes are still honoured. Its `surface` names "a page list block", its `replacement` is "delete `navigation.mode: 'drawer' | 'page' | 'new_window'`", its `reason` says "deleting `page` or `drawer` is safe", and its `acceptanceCriteria` ends "No source still declares `drawer`, `page` or `new_window`". The same `reason` then says renderers outside the object list still read the value, and they do: `useNavigationOverlay` (`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts` 425–465, untouched) routes `page` to the record page, `new_window` to a new tab and an absent mode to the drawer, for every page block that takes `NavigationConfigSchema` by reference (seven carriers in `component.zod.ts`). An upgrader who meets the acceptance sentence on a page list block turns "rows open the page" into "rows open the drawer". The same over-reach is in the describe: `[DEPRECATED] … Omit the key.` sits on the shared member, so `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` now prints it on all seven block carriers, without the "renderers outside that list still read the value" sentence that only the JSDoc holds, and against `component.zod.ts`'s own "`mode` one of the four `NavigationModeSchema` values". Scope the entry's surface, replacement, safety claim and acceptance sentence to a list view and an object's `listViews`; put the carve-out for block carriers in the describe text itself.

S1 (should-fix) — `openNewTab` is the one sibling key this PR keeps live and widens, and the contract does not say so. The entry never names it: its `replacement` for `new_window` is "nothing", when `openNewTab: true` is the supported way to keep that behaviour. The describe at `view.zod.ts` 3010 and its copy at `view.form.ts` 302 still read "Force open in new tab (applies to page mode)", which points an author at the deprecated key and no longer matches the code (it applies under any mode but `none`, on a non-phone viewport). The console's zh-CN copy (`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts` 461) repeats it.

S2 (should-fix) — `view.zod.ts` still teaches `mode` as the lever in text an author meets at parse or in the reference: the `NavigationModeSchema` JSDoc and member comments (2926–2941, "`page` is for an object whose record should open as a full page"); the `modal` and `popover` prescriptions (2912, 2922, "or as the full page for an object that declares `page`"), each now followed by a FIX that says the key is deprecated; `NAVIGATION_VIEW_RETIRED` (2971, "only decides HOW the detail is surfaced (`mode`, `size`)"); and the form-view `drawer` and `drawerSide` prescriptions (5092, 5158, "a list opens a clicked record in the drawer (`navigation.mode`, the default)"). The header comment says the member sentences keep history; they are written in the present tense and now contradict the describe further down the same file.

S3 (should-fix) — a first-party authoring surface still offers the dropped modes as live choices. Studio's kanban card section (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` 1063–1238, outside the diff) writes `navigation.mode` from a "click to open" select over all four `NavigationModeSchema.options`. On an object's kanban view the Console now ignores three of them, so the control writes a `[DEPRECATED]` key with no effect and nothing tells the author. Fix it here or name a follow-up card on the PR; neither #35870 nor #35875 covers it.

N1 (nit) — on a phone `none` and `preventNavigation` are not honoured: the hook returns the derived mobile surface (line 196) before it reads either (202–206). Unchanged from main, but the entry's "opens no record on any click" has no phone carve-out. Card it or add the carve-out.

N2 (nit) — the entry's own acceptance sentence is unmet in the tree: `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts` 66–71 declares `mode: 'drawer'` under a comment that says this is "where the open mode lives". Follow-up card.

N3 (nit) — stale prose beside the change: `recordDrawerStack.tsx` 36–38 and 852 ("the page where the object declares `navigation.mode: 'page'`", reading an object-level key the object schema does not declare); `packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.ts` 94 and 160 ("an explicit … `navigation.mode` wins"); the `view.list.navigation` liveness note cites `ObjectView.tsx:987`, and the read moved to `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`.

What holds: the deprecation route is the right one. The key stays, the default stays, nothing fails to load, a D3 semantic entry with no D2 conversion is correct because stripping `none` would change behaviour, and the form help text copies the describe as its pin requires. On the object list the entry's ignored-versus-honoured account matches the code.

## 维护者速读
- 按席位复核意见收窄了范围：「废弃打开方式设置」只针对对象列表；页面里嵌入的列表、时间线等区块，仍按原来的设置打开记录。
